decoder.slot_rule: argmax only over values valid for selected intent

training_constraints.data: local AI231 ME2 voice-command corpus and derived training-only augmentation

evaluation_scope: The dataset test split and tune-OOS pool were used for neural-model validation and selection. Holdout audio was not used for neural-weight training, fine-tuning, checkpoint selection, or interpolation. After those choices were fixed, error analysis on the 96 real holdout clips informed the PAUSE=-3.0 and CREATE_REMINDER=0.5 post-inference rejection margins, so reported holdout accuracy is a development result rather than a blind estimate.
